description: This file defines an API authentication strategy class for a NestJS application, handling multiple authentication methods including OAuth, API keys, access tokens, and NextAuth. It includes methods for validating tokens, retrieving user info, and managing authentication flow.

classes.name: ApiAuthStrategy
classes.description: A NestJS Passport strategy class handling multiple authentication methods including OAuth, API keys, access tokens, and NextAuth, with validation and user retrieval logic.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Main method to authenticate incoming requests based on provided tokens and credentials, supporting multiple auth methods.

methods.name: getSuccessUser
methods.description: Constructs a user object with admin status for successful authentication.

methods.name: authenticateOAuthClient
methods.description: Authenticates OAuth client credentials and retrieves associated user.

methods.name: oAuthClientStrategy
methods.description: Validates OAuth client ID and secret, retrieves associated user and organization.

methods.name: authenticateBearerToken
methods.description: Validates bearer tokens, distinguishing between API keys and access tokens.

methods.name: apiKeyStrategy
methods.description: Validates API key, checks license, and retrieves user.

methods.name: accessTokenStrategy
methods.description: Validates access token, origin, and retrieves user.

methods.name: nextAuthStrategy
methods.description: Validates NextAuth token and retrieves user.

methods.name: validateThirdPartyAccessToken
methods.description: Decodes and validates third-party access tokens, retrieves associated user.
